spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (कथयति)
To speak, to tell.

f. (-था)
A feigned story, a tale or fable.
E.
कथ to tell, &c. अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 A narrator, a relator, one who recites a story, or who publicly reads and expounds the Purāṇas, &c.
2 One who speaks or tells.
mf. (-कः-का)
The speaker of a prologue or a monologue.
2 A professional story teller.
E.
कथ to speak, to relate, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
An interrogant, one who asks or questions.
E.
कथम् how, कथ to speak, ठक् aff.

f. (-ता)
A question, asking, enquiring.
E.
तल् affix of the abstract added to the preceding.

m. (-तः)
An interrogant, one who questions.
E.
कथम् how, कथित said.

ind.
In some way, in any way, by any means.
E.
कथम् and चन aff.

ind.
In any way, by some means or other.
E.
कथम् and चित् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Talkative.
n. (-नं)
Saying, narrating, relating.
E.
कथ to say, &c. युच् or ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be said, to be told or declared.
E.
कथ to tell, अनीयर् affix; also with तव्य, कथितव्य, and with यत्, कथ्य.

f. (-ता)
Enquiry, question, demand.
E.
कथ to speak, भश् aff.

ind.
1 A particle of interrogation, (how, what.)
2 Also implying mode, (how, in what manner.)
3 A particle of amazement or surprise.
4 Of pleasure.
5 Of abuse.
6 Of interrogation, implying doubt.
E.
किम् what, and थमु aff.

m. (-गः)
Attention, taking pleasure in a discourse.
E.
कथा, and अनुराग inclination.

m. (-न्धः)
A narrative, a tale, a fiction.
E.
कथा, and प्रबन्ध connexion.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
1 Talkative, talking much and foolishly.
2 Half-witted, foolish.
3 A conjuror, a dealer in antidotes, &c.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Talking, conversation, speaking to or with.
2 Rumour, report.
E.
कथा a fable, and प्रसङ्ग who relates.

m. (-णः)
1 An actor, the speaker of a prologue or monologue, the introducer or a drama.
2 A professed story teller.
E.
कथा, and प्राण life, livelihood.

m. (-गः)
Conversation, talk, discourse.
E.
कथा, and योग uniting.

m. (-म्भः)
1 Narration, narrative, story telling.
2 Beginning of a story.
E.
कथा, and आरम्भ beginning, &c.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Reserved, taciturn, disliking conversation.
E.
कथा, and विरक्त disliking.

m. (-हः)
A collection of tales or fables.
E.
कथा, and संग्रह collection.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
A story teller by profession, a narrator, a relator.
E.
कथा a tale, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging to a story, told in it, &c.
m. (-कः)
A narrator.
E.
कथा and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Said, told, related.
E.
कथ to tell, क्त aff.

n. (-दं)
Repetition, tautology.
E.
कथित said, पद a word.

m. (-तः)
The opening of a drama, by the character that first enters overhearing and repeating the last words of the prelude.
E.
कथा, and उद्घात beginning.

m. (-नं)
1 Conversation, conference.
2 Narration.
E.
कथा, and उपकथन speaking.

n. (-नं)
Narration, narrative, relation, telling a story.
E.
कथा, and उपाख्यान telling.

mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं)
To be spoken or said.
E.
कथ and यत् aff.
